part.label: Corner Counterbore With Target Instance
part.description: A mounting plate with a 2x2 corner bolt pattern of holes, where only one corner (an alignment/keying corner) gets a counterbore for a flush fastener head -- relation.targetInstance anchors the counterbore to one specific instance of the patterned hole instead of its pattern center, the addressed alternative to authoring that one corner as a separate, non-patterned hole+counterbore pair.

features.description: Four-corner bolt pattern, instances indexed 0..3 in (i, j) row-major order per docs/composable-parts.md, "Patterns" -- instance 3 is (i=1, j=1), the +X +Y corner.
Counterbore on just the keying corner (instance 3), not every corner -- deliberately not given a matching pattern of its own.
